description: This PHP class defines the model for detailed vacancy information within the recruitment API of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits for serialization, mapping a Vacancy entity to a structured API response with properties like job title, hiring manager, and vacancy details.

classes.name: VacancyDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class representing detailed vacancy information for serialization in the recruitment API, mapping data from a Vacancy entity to a structured object with nested relations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a Vacancy entity, setting serialization filters and attribute mappings.
